description: This file is a shell script used for uploading logs and stress test logs in an embedded device environment. It includes functions for logging, handling TLS connections, uploading via HTTP/S3, and managing log files, with specific handling depending on device type and device properties.

methods.name: uploadLog
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp and script information to the log file.

methods.name: logTLSError
methods.description: Logs TLS connection errors based on curl return codes.

methods.name: HttpLogUpload
methods.description: Handles the process of uploading logs via HTTP, including retries and S3 upload if applicable.

methods.name: uploadLogOnReboot
methods.description: Prepares logs and calls upload functions during system reboot or script execution.
